title: Arduino Drawbridge
highlight: 2nd of 50+ at the 2023 Freshman Engineering Competition
summary: A model drawbridge that senses an approaching boat, stops traffic and lifts its span on its own.
problem: Build a working system for the CETA Design Expo inside a 6 ft × 6 ft footprint, using one Arduino and at least two sensors from the ELEGOO kit, in the few weeks between mid-November and early December.
approach: Ultrasonic sensors under the bridge watch for a passing boat. After several consistent readings the Arduino drives two stepper motors that wind string to raise the popsicle-stick span, swings two servo roadblocks down across the road, and switches LED signals for cars and boats.
result: The project placed 2nd of 50+ at the 2023 Freshman Engineering Competition. At the expo the span raised and the roadblocks lowered on command; connecting the ultrasonic trigger to the stop/go LEDs was the remaining step.
